title: DappRank
tagline: DappRank ranks DeFi Dapps via SRWV fan voting, rewards developers, burns votes, stops whales fairly.
description: DappRank is a A DeFi Dapp ranking model that incentivizes developers.  DappRank is a list of the best Dapps which subscribes and have fans that vote for them using SRWV model, the Dapps developers gets rewards by the system and burns a percentage of the votes to try to keep an ultrasound money model. The DappRank DeFi model introduces a revolutionary decentralized ranking system for Dapps using a novel voting mechanism called Square Root Weighted Voting (SRWV). This system addresses the critical issue of whale manipulation
